answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of 35 judged findings, 27 map to seeded defects, 6 are real but not seeded (F-0022, F-0024, F-0056, F-0061, F-0062, F-0067) and 2 are not problems (F-0047, F-0068): precision = 33/35 = 0.94; strict precision (seeded only) = 27/35 = 0.77. Recall by meaning is 14/14 counting the tool findings (D02 is covered only by tool finding F-0019), or 13/14 from judged findings alone.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a numbered 'What to fix first' list, starting with the double-tap cancellation (severity 4) and the required mobile number, and puts the rest under 'Next tier'. Its 'Not covered' section names what needs a person: 'Real screen readers: I didn't use VoiceOver or TalkBack', zoom and high-contrast themes not tested, 'no one from the public has tried the flow', and it asks for the live date and the share of landline-only households to be confirmed.

mapping.title: Slot-count status message not announced
mapping.reason: The '20 slots free' line's live region is created together with its text, so a screen reader is never told the count. This is D11.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot 08:00
mapping.reason: Slot buttons show no focus ring.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots shown above Morning heading, out of DOM and time order
mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved to the front of the grid, out of time and reading order, and the headings no longer sit above their slots.

mapping.title: Selected day button indistinguishable under forced colours
mapping.reason: Measured, not speculative: in high-contrast mode the pressed day differs only by a slightly different border hue, so a low-vision resident using forced colours cannot see which day button is selected. It is minor, because the day is restated in text, but it is a real accessibility gap that is not seeded.

mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' for a cancelled booking
mapping.reason: The cancelled state comes from the double press. D09 names this exact harm: the done page is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate'.

mapping.title: Current step in Steps list marked only by bold
mapping.reason: There is no aria-current or other programmatic state, so screen-reader users cannot tell which step of the booking they are on. That is a genuine 1.3.1 problem and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no next step
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses the message says only 'This slot is no longer available.', the slot is dropped, and the message neither explains it nor offers a way forward. That is D08's harm.

mapping.title: Injected .slot:focus rule removes focus outline
mapping.reason: This is the cause of D05: a style the script injects removes the slot buttons' outline and nothing replaces it.

mapping.title: Double activation of 'Book this slot' cancels the booking
mapping.reason: A second press while the booking is pending turns it into a cancellation. This is D09.

mapping.title: Booking wait and slot loading show no visible progress
mapping.reason: It describes the slot grid and status text cleared for 900 ms with nothing in their place, and Next returning silently. That is D01's wait. It also restates D09's booking wait, but only one id can be given.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than its container at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: The script sizes the grid from the window width, so it overflows at 360 px and below.

mapping.title: Permit field visible for every vehicle (.field overrides hidden)
mapping.reason: It concerns the permit field's show/hide logic on the vehicle step, including the 1200 ms delayed reveal. The instructions place the delayed permit field under D07.

mapping.title: Today's past slots offered, rejected only at final booking
mapping.reason: Today's started slots are offered as free and refused only at Book, in an error with no link. This is D06.

mapping.title: Permit format and closed-day checks only at final booking, unlinked
mapping.reason: The permit rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field and gives no way back to it. This is D07.

mapping.title: Five-minute hold expires with no warning or extension
mapping.reason: The hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped at booking.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag below 4.5:1 contrast
mapping.reason: About 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark mode for 16 px bold text. This is D03.

mapping.title: 'Few left' colours are not DESIGN.md roles
mapping.reason: It names the same tag colours (cited under 1.4.3) and says the declared warning role should be used. Using that role would fix the contrast failure, which D03 traces to colours computed at run time rather than declared.

mapping.title: Slot end time and arrival rule only in title tooltip
mapping.reason: Slot length, end time and the arrival rule are only in a tooltip that touch users never see.

mapping.title: No loading indication while slots load
mapping.reason: The Slots area is blank for about 1 s with nothing saying slots are coming.

mapping.title: No in-progress indication while booking is submitted
mapping.reason: Book does nothing visible for about 1.5 s. The instructions place this under D09.

mapping.title: No notice that the slot is held or for how long
mapping.reason: No page shows the hold or its end. This is D08.

mapping.title: Expired-slot error does not explain or guide recovery
mapping.reason: The slot shows as '-' and the message 'no longer available' gives no reason and no prompt to pick a new slot. That is D08's dropped-hold harm.

mapping.title: Booked page omits day, slot time and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, slot and vehicle.

mapping.title: Change slot opens a fresh booking page on Today
mapping.reason: After 'Change slot', Today is pressed rather than Saturday 17 and no slot is selected: the chosen day and slot are forgotten. This is D12.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show chosen day and slot
mapping.reason: The day and slot were chosen on the step just before and are restated on Check and book before anything is booked. The review shows no way a resident is misled or harmed.

mapping.title: Change slot and Back to the slots reopen on Today
mapping.reason: Returning to change the slot forgets the chosen day and slot. This is D12.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening or for weekends, but the only route to change or cancel is a phone line open weekdays 09:00 to 17:00. Someone who cannot come has no practical way to free or move the slot. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Slot list goes blank under previous day's date while loading
mapping.reason: The grid empties with no loading message while slots are on their way. That is D01's wait, here with a stale label.

mapping.title: Slots already started today can be chosen
mapping.reason: At 10:05 today, 08:00 to 10:00 are offered as free and can be chosen. This is D06.

mapping.title: Mobile number required though hinted as only for a reminder
mapping.reason: The hint reads as optional, yet a blank field or a landline blocks booking. Residents without a mobile cannot book at all, and others hit an unexpected error. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Permit help says apply on council site but gives no link
mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner told they need a permit is given no link or address to apply, which is a dead end in the help. D07 covers how the rule is surfaced and enforced, not the missing application route.

mapping.title: Waste list editable only via link labelled 'Change vehicle'
mapping.reason: On Check and book the Waste row has no change link, and the link that does lead there is labelled 'Change vehicle'. A resident who wants to fix their waste list cannot tell how. Not seeded.

mapping.title: After invalid date, slots area still shows previous day
mapping.reason: The review says the inline error is clear, and the leftover result is labelled with its own day ('Wednesday 14 October'). Nothing misleads the resident, so the harm is negligible.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into unlabelled group
mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved ahead of the Morning and Afternoon grids, out of time order. This is D10.

mapping.title: Done page shows reference but not day, slot or vehicle
mapping.reason: The day, slot and vehicle are missing from the done page.

mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure (3.02:1)
mapping.reason: Tool finding: the 'Few left' tag's colours (#bd7d0f on #fbefda) fail 4.5:1.

mapping.title: Text contrast below 4.5:1: 'Few left'
mapping.reason: Tool finding: 'Few left' at 3.02:1.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Tool finding: the slots area overflows at 320 px.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Tool finding: the same slot-grid overflow at 320 px.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
mapping.reason: Tool finding: focus jumps around the grid because 'Few left' slots are reordered visually.

mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
mapping.reason: Tool finding: the 1.2 s wait after choosing a vehicle that needs a permit is the delayed permit-field reveal of D07.

mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget on /
mapping.reason: Tool finding: CLS 0.169, with #opening moved when the slots arrive. This is D02.
